title: 10 Mutant Animals Created by Scientists Recently
description:
These mutant animals were created by scientists. For decades, animal doctors have been changing the genes of animals to give them desirable characters or traits. It is made possible by different gene-editing techniques like hybrid animals that have revolutionized the world. It also aims to eliminate different diseases caused by animals by mutating them with safer genes.  Let’s start!
